entries.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
entries.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

entries.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
entries.summary: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

entries.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions

entries.title: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
entries.summary: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

entries.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
entries.summary: See how Amp pushes the frontier of what agents can do with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.

entries.title: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
entries.summary: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

entries.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours

entries.title: How Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI technology
entries.summary: Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI. Its security team investigates threats faster and proposes patches in minutes.

entries.title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
entries.summary: New analysis shows how agentic AI adoption is growing across EU enterprises and small businesses—and where deeper use could unlock more value.

entries.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
